subtitle: Marigold Fizzwhistle, one-on-one on Thursday, November 12 at 10:00 AM MT
headline: Closings are behind pace.

findings.text: 11 closings against a year-to-date goal of 18, a pace of 72.4%.
Appointments met fell from 9 in September to 6 in October.
One of two commitments from last time is done.
